pageTitle: "Golden Vow" Candace Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise
name: "Golden Vow" Candace Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Aaru Village lies on the edge of the desert. Though it is cut off by the Wall of Samiel, it is still a safe place that welcomes those who wish for rest. As the Guardian of Aaru Village, Candace's job is to keep the village safe. People have differing views on Candace. While The Eremites regard her as a true descendant of King Deshret, with the terrifying power to control the desert, young adventurers who have been to the desert have found her warm and kind... But Candace cares little for others' opinions of her. In Candace's case, anyone can rest and seek help in Aaru Village so long as they abide by the rules. If anyone breaks those rules and intends to do harm, Candace will not hesitate to take care of them personally. Candace has made protecting Aaru Village her top priority. So, dear Traveler, what is it that you hold dear, that you want to protect the most? (*╹▽╹*)
